title: Ave regina celorum (La Rue)
desc: Pierre de la Rue, Ave regina celorum. 4 voices (Discantus, Contra, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Rue2001); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
